grammarFocus: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing 的常见用法；基础被动语态入门。
title: The Smart Speaker Setup
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 10 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。判断题 True 表示原文明示支持，False 表示原文明示矛盾，Not Given 表示缺少判断所需信息。
transcript:
Mia: Hi Tom! I'm trying to set up my new smart speaker, but it's not working. Can you help me?
Tom: Sure, Mia. Let's see. First, is it plugged in?
Mia: Yes, the speaker is plugged in. I checked the power cable. The light is on.
Tom: Okay. Maybe you need to restart your phone. Sometimes the app gets stuck.
Mia: I already did that. It didn't help.
Tom: Hmm. Let me think. Oh, did you check the Wi-Fi password? The speaker needs the correct password to connect.
Mia: I think so. But let me try again. ... Oh! I see the problem. I typed the password wrong. Now it's working!
Tom: Great! Next time, once the power is on, check the Wi-Fi password before restarting the phone.
Mia: Yes, I'll remember that. Thanks!
Tom: You're welcome. Also, you should update the app to get new features.
Mia: Good idea. I'll do that later. By the way, my sister has a smart speaker too. She uses it to play music and listen to the news.
Tom: That's cool. Smart speakers are very useful. They can help you do many things.
Mia: Yes, I agree. But sometimes they make mistakes. Yesterday, my speaker played a song when I asked for the weather.
Tom: Ha! That happens. You need to speak clearly. And remember that a working connection matters too.
Mia: I won't. Thanks for your help, Tom.
Tom: No problem. See you later!

questions.prompt: What is Mia trying to do?
options: Set up a new smart speaker
answers: Set up a new smart speaker

questions.evidence: I'm trying to set up my new smart speaker

questions.explanation: 在 Mia 确认通电以后，Tom 建议重启手机。题目限定了这一次建议所在的位置。
questions.evidence: Maybe you need to restart your phone.

questions.prompt: For next time, what does Tom recommend checking after the power and before restarting the phone?
questions.explanation: 这是故障解决后 Tom 对下次操作顺序的建议：确认通电后，先核对 Wi-Fi 密码，再考虑重启手机。
questions.evidence: Next time, once the power is on, check the Wi-Fi password before restarting the phone.

questions.explanation: Mia说：'The light is on.'，所以填on。

questions.prompt: What was the problem with the smart speaker?
options: The phone app was not installed

grammar.title: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing；基础被动语态
grammar.explanation: to do 可以表示目的，例如 update the app to get new features 中，to get new features 说明更新应用的目的。to do 也可跟在某些动词后补充意思，如 need to restart、try to set up；try to set up 是“尝试设置”，并非本身就是目的状语。enjoy、finish 等后常接 doing。被动语态用 be + 过去分词，表示主语承受动作，如 The speaker is plugged in.。

questions.prompt: She went to the store ______ a new phone.
questions.explanation: 表示去商店的目的，用 to buy。
questions.evidence: She went to the store to buy a new phone.

questions.explanation: 此处 need 后接 to do，说明需要做的事。
questions.evidence: I need to check the password.

questions.prompt: Use the passive voice: The app ______ on my phone.
questions.explanation: 题目明确要求被动语态，应用是被安装的，用 is installed。
questions.evidence: The app is installed on my phone.

questions.prompt: He enjoys ______ music on his speaker.
questions.evidence: He enjoys playing music on his speaker.
